summary: Buy 31 ceiling air devices: 28 ceiling supply diffusers and 3 ceiling return/exhaust grilles. Ceiling supply (all Price, white finish): tag A = Price SCD 6" round neck in 24x24 lay-in panel, 5 ea (75/75/75/90/130 CFM); tag B = SCD 8" neck, 4 ea (150/150/140/140); tag C = SCD 10" neck, 15 ea (250x3, 200x2, 350x3, 300x2, 375x4); tag D = SCD 12" neck, 1 ea (500). Those four are louvered-face square 4-cone steel diffusers with fixed 360-degree discharge, full-faced louvers, factory-insulated backpan, NC not to exceed 35, each in a 24x24 lay-in ceiling panel, and each needs a Price VCR9 radial balancing damper in the neck (M601 note 12). Tag J = Price SMD, 12x12 face with 8" round neck, white, 4-way, high-capacity louvered face with opposed-blade damper and flanged frame for surface mounting (hard-ceiling toilet rooms), 3 ea (175/150/150). Total ceiling supply airflow = 6,550 CFM. Ceiling return/exhaust: tag F = Price model 80, 24"x24" core, all-aluminum 1/2" x 1/2" x 1/2" egg crate, core-only panel in a 24x24 lay-in panel, white, 3 ea - two in MTG Room 106 (contractor also furnishes a new 24x24 lined plenum atop each, M101 note 4) and one at FCU-1 in MP Room 119 (rectangular-to-round adapter, M101 note 28). Do NOT order grilles for the three ceiling exhaust fans: EF-1 and EF-2 (Greenheck SP-A700, 450 CFM each) and EF-3 (Greenheck SP-B90, 75 CFM) are centrifugal ceiling exhaust fans with integral grille - on the plan their hexagons carry a dash instead of a grille letter. Separately, and NOT part of the ceiling count, there are 15 wall-mounted devices: tag E, 4 ea Price 95 approx 30x18 sidewall return (field verify size, M101 note 7); tag G, 4 ea Price 95 36x36 sidewall transfer grille at 14'-8" AFF; tag H, 3 ea Price 520D 18x8 double-deflection sidewall supply at 550 CFM, bottom at 11'-11" AFF; tag I, 4 ea Price 520D 14x8 double-deflection sidewall supply at 450 CFM (field verify size). E, G, H and I are primecoat and require 2 coats of field paint, color verified with the architect. There is also one 14x14 egg crate (Price model 82) mounted in a soffit with an insect screen on the back (M101 note 19) - a soffit outside-air intake, not a ceiling vent. Method and confidence: I counted the tagged hexagons on M101 two independent ways - by text glyph and by hexagon vector outline - and both give 49 tags (46 lettered + 3 exhaust-fan tags), so the count is clean. Demolition sheet MD101 (notes 8, 14, 16, 42) confirms every removed grille is replaced with a new grille, with nothing salvaged or reused, so all 31 ceiling units are new purchases. Before ordering, note M601 general note 3 and the architect's reflected ceiling plan A6-1: coordinate exact diffuser locations with the lighting layout, sprinkler heads and ceiling grid.
